Strait of Hormuz over the last 24 hours: Where is the fucking deal?

Uh oh, do you smell that?

Yeah, that's the smell of bullshit.

We went from Tuesday's "opening within hours" to Axios's Wednesday announcement to nothing. 

Meanwhile, Iranian news appears to point out a deal that looks nothing like a deal. It looks like a straight rejection of everything the US wants.

And even as the talks continue, the US continues to escort a convoy of tankers through the Oman lane. This time, Iranian forces fired missiles at the ships. 

Nissos Keros turned off its AIS right before it transited the Oman lane and remains off. No UKMTO report, nothing. I guess we won't know until satellite images show up.

So will there be a deal? 

Well, with each passing day without an announcement, the likelihood of a deal diminishes. Trump's own 48-hour timeline has gone and passed. 

It's now or never. 

Video from @MarineTraffic.

#Japan's biggest refiner, Eneos Corp, restarted the 175,000 barrels-per-day crude distillation unit at its Kashima refinery on Thursday following scheduled maintenance, a company spokesperson said on Friday.

The unit had been shut since May 14 for a turnaround.
